message:
8 MB uploads are accepted now. The upload limit in `config/default.json` was set to 5 MB. I changed `uploads.maxMb` to 10 to match `docs/product.md`, and `npm test` passes (4 of 4).

The API's request body limit (`src/api/body-limit.js`) is computed from that setting, so it is now 11 MB. I didn't run a real upload through the API.
